## Arrowhawk (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 N Medium outsider (air, extraplanar)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +11  

**Defense**

 **AC** 2, touch 16, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural)  
 **hp** 77 (7d10+7)  
 **Fort** +3, **Ref** +10, **Will** +6  
 **Immune** acid, electricity, poison; **Resist** cold 10, fire 10  

**Offense**

 **Speed** fly 60 ft. (perfect)  
 **Melee** bite +12 (1d8+6)  
 **Ranged** **Touch** electricity ray +12 (2d8)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 21, **Con** 12, **Int** 10, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 13  
 **Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 25  
 **Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Flyby Attack, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Wind Stance  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Fly +23, Knowledge (planes) +10, Perception +11, Sense Motive +11, Stealth +15, Survival +11  
 **Language** Auran  

**Special Abilities**

 **Electricity Ray (Su)**  The arrowhawk can fire a ray of electricity once per round to a range of 50 feet.  

 **Razor Beak (Ex)**  The arrowhawk’s beak is a serrated cutting weapon. Its bite deals damage as if it were a creature one size larger.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Plane of Air)  
 **Organization** solitary or clutch (2-4)  
 **Treasure** none
